'''Reye Nenilin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who was an expert in genetics during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was approached in the [[Haunch of Nerf]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] [[Mij Gilamar]], [[Kal Skirata|Kal]] and [[Mereel Skirata]], who gave him a part of some genetic research that had been obtained from [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]], to see if he could do anything with it, to control the aging process in [[Cloning/Legends|clones]].

Nenilin hoped to use the data to win the [[Republic Science Acolade]], but he soon realized that it was of [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] origin. He handed it over to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in hope that its shady origins wouldn't ruin his chance of getting the reward. However, Nenilin went missing shortly afterward.
